item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Medication. You've got a routine dose sitting on the schedule this morning, and routines only work if you actually run them, not just glance at them. No new heroics needed today — just consistency, taken on time, no skipping because the day feels busy. Medication is the boring part of the plan, but boring is what makes the rest of it possible. Action: take it now, before anything else pulls your attention.
